name: Coalesced editorial autosave
trigger: Tab becomes idle after a legitimate edit or Save now
effect_identity: Resource + actor session + lease generation + request fingerprint
effect: Validate structure, reprove lease/revision/permission; commit content and receipt together. No ordinary notifications, Git builds or public effects.
retry: Serialize/coalesce; same command/key on lost acknowledgement; stop successor saves for stale/revoked/unknown outcome.
cancellation: Hide/suspend stops renewal; preserve tab work; no persistent offline queue.
visibility: Existing D12 status control; cause-owned compare/repair.

name: Acknowledged working-preview refresh
effect: Refresh only the saved preview version; later local edits labelled unsaved. Never publish.
retry: Deduplicate/coalesce obsolete requests; a failed renderer does not roll back the saved draft.
cancellation: Discard obsolete UI responses by scope/revision; not a source rollback.

name: Source discovery and reconciliation
trigger: Verified bound Git event or permitted Check source
effect_identity: Binding epoch + repository ID + exact commit + package root + policy
effect: Persist event before dispatch; discover eligible revision and request a bounded capture/build. No source writes or automatic activation.
retry: Authenticated webhook receipt dedupe plus business identity; shared bounded reconcile for missed deliveries.
cancellation: Binding revoke fences new intake. Superseding a discovery does not cancel explicit reviewed work without policy.

name: Clean build and qualification
trigger: Authorized exact capture accepted for build
effect_identity: Capture digest + toolchain/recipe/policy + request identity; attempts separate
effect: Claim product work; run isolated code; record exact artifact/evidence; hand to independent admission. Never grant the worker serving-head writes.
retry: Transient infrastructure retries bounded; deterministic code/schema failures stop with diagnostics; reconcile unknown external task before retry.
cancellation: Fence commits then terminate best-effort. A completed canceled attempt remains history, not admitted success.
visibility: Bounded log/proof projection and responsible maintainer.

name: Fixed preview/candidate preparation
trigger: Authorized exact preview selection or design-review request
effect_identity: Exact selected closure + artifact/settings + profile + policy
effect: Briefly snapshot, compile outside locks, reprove and seal complete candidate or none. Later drafts not silently included.
retry: Current expected-head races obey owning reprepare rules; unknown receipt looked up.
cancellation: Cancel/expire prevents further candidate use; does not alter live heads.

name: Scheduled publication executor
trigger: D13 appointment reaches bounded handoff/due time
effect_identity: Appointment ID + generation + immutable action fingerprint
effect: Read organization authorization and current safety; execute the same D1 command, preserving unrelated work.
retry: Shared ledger/claim and overdue recovery; no-before time; stale event no-op; semantic conflict needs attention.
cancellation: Generation-fenced cancel/replace; cannot undo committed effect.

name: Public projection convergence
effect_identity: Generation receipt + projection owner + target version
effect: Dispatch identifier-only intents; make derived systems reflect committed public generation. No new favorable authority.
retry: Version-aware replay ignores older favorable results; own proof/read policy handles current adverse safety.
cancellation: Contained affected projection; never roll back content because a notification failed.

name: Adverse public safety containment
trigger: Current source owner withdraws eligibility/rights or revokes package
effect: Suppress through authoritative read/egress boundary immediately; invalidate dependent previews/candidates and converge caches.
retry: Idempotent adverse replay; prioritize over routine build jobs. No wait for optional webhook or search index.
cancellation: Only source-authorized successor can restore; no general retry that clears a restriction.
visibility: Visible private owning cause, no restricted public explanation.

name: Compatibility and impact refresh
trigger: Qualified manifest/catalog/settings change or authorized impact query
effect_identity: Exact version tuple + scope + projection epoch
effect: Derive affected Page count/details allowed by permission; detect unsupported bindings. No automatic content mutation.
retry: Bounded incremental rebuild; incomplete projection labelled unknown, never unused.
cancellation: Newer version supersedes projected result without altering history.
visibility: Change impact and proposed repair/upgrade plan.

name: Repository lifecycle handling
trigger: Verified transfer/archive/remove/visibility event or explicit disconnect
effect_identity: Provider event + binding epoch + current provider evidence
effect: Rename updates labels; ownership/control changes require re-verification; disconnect fences new source work. Preserve admitted safe artifacts.
retry: Reconcile ambiguous provider outcome; outage is not proof of deletion. Older events cannot reactivate access.
cancellation: Explicit reconnect verifies both domains and increments epoch.
visibility: Actionable connection state without affecting routine editor access.

name: Dispatch and unknown-outcome recovery
trigger: Shared recovery scan finds accepted unhandled/uncertain work
effect: Repair delivery or query original outcome under current registered purpose. Do not invent success from queue status.
retry: Bounded backoff and claim fencing; semantic failure routed to owner; provider dedupe window not sufficient.
cancellation: Disabled dispatch retains product records and manual safe recovery.
visibility: One grouped cause-owned exception, no per-retry notifications.

name: Preview expiry and retained-artifact maintenance
trigger: Qualified expiry/retention job or authorized maintenance request
effect_identity: Expired preview or retention decision + exact resource version
effect: Expire grants/compute; derive retained use evidence; purge only separately authorized eligible disposable bytes.
retry: Idempotent operations with unknown deletion reconciliation; missing references block disposal.
cancellation: Legal/operational holds and active references take precedence; no age-only admitted-artifact purge.
visibility: Capacity/expiry view and exact custody receipt, no raw bucket repair.
